definition: A poor or unfavorable working environment
examples: Many workers went on strike due to the bad conditions in the factory.

definition: To have a system of working a set number of hours with the starting and finishing times chosen within agreed limits by the employee
examples: I am lucky to be on flexitime, so I can start work at 10 AM if I want to.

definition: To have control and authority over something or someone and the duty of taking care of it, him, or her
examples: As a manager, she will be responsible for overseeing the entire project.

definition: An unsafe working environment that poses a risk to health or life
examples: Miners often have to work underground in very dangerous conditions.

definition: To take action to do something, especially to solve a problem
examples: Customer service representatives deal with complaints on a daily basis.

definition: To work during different parts of the day or night (e.g., morning shift, night shift)
examples: Nurses and doctors usually have to do shift work at the hospital.

definition: To obtain money in return for labor or services
examples: He wants to find a new job where he can earn a higher salary.

definition: A person employed for wages or salary, especially at non-executive level
examples: The company currently has over five hundred employees.

definition: Practical contact with and observation of facts or events; knowledge or skill acquired over time
examples: She has a lot of experience in marketing and public relations.

definition: Standard office working hours
examples: Most office workers in the city work from nine to five.
translation: с девяти до пяти (стандартный рабочий день)

definition: Occupying or using the whole of someone's available working time
examples: She is looking for a full-time job now that she has graduated.

definition: Favorable or pleasant working environments
examples: The tech company is famous for providing good conditions for its staff.

definition: Into or inside a building
examples: During the rainy season, we prefer to stay indoors.

definition: A working day that lasts longer than the standard amount of time
examples: Lawyers often have to work long hours to prepare for a big trial.

definition: Relating to or done with the hands
examples: Construction work involves a lot of heavy manual labor.

definition: In or into the open air; outside a building or shelter
examples: He loves his job as a gardener because he gets to work outdoors.

definition: In addition to normal working hours
examples: They had to work overtime to meet the project deadline.

definition: Routine work involving written documents such as forms, records, or letters
examples: The job is interesting, but there is far too much paperwork.

definition: For only part of the usual working day or week
examples: Many students take part-time jobs to earn some extra pocket money.

definition: A pass of an examination or an official completion of a course, especially one conferring status as a recognized practitioner of a profession or activity
examples: You need a teaching qualification to work at this school.

definition: A fixed regular payment, typically paid on a monthly basis, made by an employer to an employee
examples: The starting salary for this position is very competitive.

definition: Working for oneself as a freelance or the owner of a business rather than for an employer
examples: As a freelance graphic designer, he has been self-employed for years.

definition: Having or showing the knowledge, ability, or training to perform a certain activity or task well
examples: We are looking to hire a highly skilled software engineer.

definition: Causing mental or emotional stress
examples: Working in an emergency room can be an incredibly stressful job.

definition: The action of teaching a person or animal a particular skill or type of behavior
examples: New employees must undergo two weeks of intensive training.

definition: Earning or paying a lot of money
examples: Dentistry is considered a very well-paid profession.

definition: To make a formal, usually written, request for employment
examples: He decided to apply for a job at the new marketing agency.
translation: устраиваться на работу / подать заявку на работу

definition: To lose one's job and be without work
examples: Many people became unemployed when the local factory closed down.

definition: To be officially removed from a job, often for a specific reason
examples: He was dismissed from his post due to repeated absences.

definition: To be forced to leave a job, usually because of poor performance or bad behavior
examples: She will be fired if she shows up late one more time.

definition: To lose one's job because it is no longer necessary for the company
examples: Due to budget cuts, twenty staff members were made redundant.

definition: To be advanced to a higher position or rank within a company
examples: If she continues working this hard, she will definitely get a promotion.

definition: To voluntarily leave a job or other position
examples: The CEO decided to resign after the scandal became public.
translation: увольняться (по собственному желанию) / уходить в отставку

definition: To leave one's job and cease to work, typically upon reaching the normal age for leaving employment
examples: My grandfather plans to retire when he turns sixty-five.

definition: To reject an offer or request
examples: I had to turn down the job offer because the salary was too low.

definition: A period, typically an academic year, taken by a student as a break between school and university or college education
examples: She took a gap year to travel across South America before starting university.
translation: академический отпуск (перерыв между школой и вузом)

definition: To stop the continuous progress of an activity or process
examples: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking on the phone.
